title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on product mentions in the provided sources, favoring items cited by more than one source.
assumptions: No price information was used except where explicitly stated in a source; all other pricing is omitted.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want a home robot that can vacuum, mop and try to pick up items. It offers strong cleaning, mapping and an OmniGrip arm, but the arm still struggles with object handling and software bugs.
